title: MMDM: Measuring Massive Multitask Decision Making
abstract: arXiv:2611.14309v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: System-1 Decision Models directly make structured probabilistic decisions over query-specified options given a state in a single forward pass, without autoregressively generating reasoning trajectories or textual responses. Recent evaluations cover diverse tasks but often rely on existing benchmarks, where prior exposure to test material can obscure generalization. Moreover, real-world decision making often involves long contexts, large option spaces, and complex logical dependencies, challenges that existing benchmarks do not adequately capture together. Thus, we introduce MMDM (Massive Multitask Decision Making), a benchmark of 5,448 high-quality questions across 16 task categories, combining newly constructed tasks with source-grounded recompositions and rewrites for single-select, multi-select, and soft-label decision making in fresh contexts. translated_title: MMDM：衡量大规模多任务决策
translated_abstract: 系统-1决策模型在单次前向传播中，基于给定状态直接对查询所指定的选项做出结构化的概率决策，而无需自回归地生成推理轨迹或文本响应。近期的评估虽涵盖多样化任务，但往往依赖现有基准，而对测试材料的事先接触（数据污染）可能掩盖模型的真实泛化能力。此外，现实世界的决策常常涉及长上下文、庞大的选项空间以及复杂的逻辑依赖，而这些挑战并未被现有基准同时充分捕捉。因此，我们提出了MMDM（大规模多任务决策），这是一个包含16个任务类别、共5,448道高质量问题的基准，它将新构建的任务与基于原始来源的重组和改写相结合，用于在全新上下文中进行单选、多选和软标签决策。该基准涵盖了诸如智能体状态跟踪、工具与技能选择等真实场景（摘要原文在此处被截断）。
tldr: 提出了MMDM基准——涵盖16个任务类别、5,448道高质量问题的大规模多任务决策基准，用于在无数据污染的全新上下文中评估系统-1决策模型在单选、多选和软标签决策上的能力。
en_tdlr: We introduce MMDM, a benchmark of 5,448 high-quality questions across 16 task categories, designed to evaluate System-1 decision models on single-select, multi-select, and soft-label decision making in fresh, contamination-free contexts involving long contexts, large option spaces, and complex logical dependencies.
